title: Suggestion
description: A proposal the AI pipeline made from an Artifact (D10). It is not an entity: an Item or Relation exists only after the user accepts it with suggestion.accept. The user decides state with suggestion.accept or suggestion.dismiss and the Hub records it; the Hub writes every column. On accept of create_item, or of a patch_item whose result applies at least one key, the Hub makes one item:<id> -evidence-> blob:<sha> | capture:<id> Relation per anchor among the evidence and puts that anchor's Locators, joined with any it already has, in its locators. On accept of add_relation only an evidence Relation carries Locators, those of the evidence whose anchor is its to (rule locator_anchor); a Relation of another type has none, and its evidence stays on the Suggestion. Open, as the Hub sends it, inside proposed too: a known action is checked by its branch (known), and an unknown action matching the name pattern is kept; a client shows it and offers no accept. Clients ignore members they do not know.

source_artifact_id.description: The Artifact the proposal came from.

action.description: Known actions are the examples; a newer Hub may send others.

proposed.description: What accepting does; its shape follows action.

evidence.description: Where the proposal comes from, as Locators the Hub made from the ContentBlock ids the model cited (D13). Empty when no cited id survived the Hub's check: the proposal then shows as without evidence.

fingerprint.description: hash(action, kind, normalized key fields) as lowercase hex SHA-256: a dismissed fingerprint does not open again when the source is processed again.

state.description: The user's decision as the Hub recorded it.

conflicts_with.description: Other open Suggestions that contradict this one, such as two different due dates; the user picks one. Never its own id (rule conflict_self).

created_item_id.description: The Item that accepting a create_item made, written in the same transaction, so every device finds the Item a Suggestion became. Only an accepted Suggestion has it.

known.description: The known actions as a discriminated union.

item_proposal.description: The Item columns accepting creates: what a client's create sends (mutation item_data), but open like the Item, fields of a known kind included. The Hub picks the new Item's id.

item_patch.description: The patch of an existing Item the Hub applies on accept, compare-and-set like a client's (D18). set writes only user columns (rule owner) with values that fit them (rule set_type). Open, its set entries included.

proposed_change.description: A set entry as in a patch (mutation change), but open.
